title: Grateful Dead Live at Central Park on 1969-06-22
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > Cool Edit 2000 (pitch correction and filter) > CD (only the first 22 minutes of the show)

ai_review.summary: Great Casey Jones performance with dancing vibes, but the audience recording is poor and incomplete
ai_review.review: Fans rave about an unusually long, jam‑filled rendition of "Casey Jones" that captures a sunny, dance‑ready atmosphere, even likening it to a Central Park afternoon. However, several reviewers note that the only source available is a bad, incomplete audience tape, making the listening experience frustrating for many.

ai_rating.rationale: Performance of Casey Jones receives high praise (4‑5 stars) while the recording quality is repeatedly called hopeless, bad, and incomplete (1‑0 stars). Weighted blend of strong show but weak source yields a middle‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as 'bad', 'incomplete' and 'hopeless'; likely suffers from low fidelity, dropouts, and missing portions of the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is highlighted for its extended, dancing‑ready jam on Casey Jones; overall flow not detailed beyond that positive moment.
